name: The elopement and assassination
description: The [[Prince of Miurna]] and the [[Sultana of Caryes]] eloped and were assassinated with their young child, whose body never turned up. Some, particularly in the Order, believe the [[Engineers]] instigated it to stop a consolidation of power into a pan-continental personal union.

name: The Union of the Kingdoms breaks apart
description: The court fragments; the Union splits back into Miurna, Leantis and Godrastan, each claiming the Lost Prince as true heir: two under younger sons, one under the court elders.

name: Caryes unites with Sevine
description: Caryes negotiates a union with the Principality of Sevine, which owed fealty to the Sultana, to keep her personal union from breaking up.

name: The Order of the White Raven is founded
description: Founded at the Raven of Carrowmore public house in Linos.
